mapper.insert: insert into appuser (app_user_id, email, password, mbti_type_id, created_at, ufile, mobile, nickname, provider, provider_id ) values (appuser_seq.nextval, #{email}, #{password}, #{mbtiTypeId}, sysdate, #{ufile}, #{mobile}, #{nickname}, #{provider}, #{providerId} )
mapper.select: select u.email, u.password, a.auth from appuser u left join authorities a on u.email = a.email where u.email = #{email}
select count(*) from appuser where email = #{email}
mapper.update: update appuser set password = #{password}, mbti_type_id = #{mbtiTypeId}, ufile = #{ufile}, nickname = #{nickname}, mobile = #{mobile}, provider = #{provider}, provider_id = #{providerId} where app_user_id = #{appUserId}
mapper.insert: insert into authorities (auth_id, email, auth) values (#{authId}, #{email}, #{auth})
